answer.explanation: The live OUTPUT_BUCKET of the Compression function is the literal 'missing-bucket-lambda-rca', last modified at 00:50:44Z, one second before the window. The IaC template sets OUTPUT_BUCKET to !Ref OutputBucket, so the live value is drift from the intended state. In the window, 400+ Compression invocations fail with NoSuchBucket on PutObject (handler.py line 37), which matches the bad value. The IAM role grants s3:PutObject on the real output bucket, so this is not an IAM problem. The template is correct and the only recent template change to the thumbnailer output (commit e83110e) was a revert that now points to !Ref OutputBucket; it does not explain the Compression value. The Uploader and Thumbnailer live values match the template. Commit e83110e is listed only as a related recent template change, not as the cause.
